claims.verbatim:
Steamship Arago, Gadsden, Havre, via Falmouth Aug. 2, with mdse.
and pass. to the New-York and Havre Steamship Co. Aug. 3, lat. 49
20, long. 10 10, exchanged signals with American bark Emma Harri-
man; 5th[?], lat. 48 43, long. 20 41, exchanged signals with British ship
Merrington, of Liverpool, bound W; 13th, lat. 42 14, long. 62 02,
passed British ship Metropolis, of St. Johns, N. B.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 17 August 1866, p. 8, col. 5
